heading: CHAPTER IX.
title: CONCERNING A CIVIL PRINCIPALITY
exclusions: front matter and dedication before THE PRINCE
notes: Chapter 9 turns from conquest and wicked seizure to rule arising from civic conflict and citizen backing.
The central tension is popular favour versus noble favour, with the people easier to satisfy but indispensable in adversity.
Modern examples should preserve the chapter's two-party civic pressure without flattening it into generic stakeholder management.
